'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Allen Gaible LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Allen Gaible]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
